answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can run a stranger-posed question ledger. Each newcomer earns standing only by answering fresh questions posed by strangers, not by choosing easy tasks. Every answer is graded by the asker and two unrelated reviewers, so like light through a prism, a copied or hollow reply is split open and exposed. Grades are sealed in a cipher audit log, and scores decay each season, so a sonnet of praise earned once cannot carry an identity forever. A farm of fakes would have to answer hundreds of distinct questions well at once, which one operator cannot staff.
